summary: Cherry Hill Interiors Pvt. declaration.preface: Cherry Hill Interiors Pvt. Ltd. is a leading pan-India player in occupancy services, specializing in corporate office interiors, hospitals, and hotels. As a member of the U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) and the Indian Green Building Council (IGBC), and holding ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015, and 18001:2007 certifications, we are committed to embedding sustainability into our business practices. Our approach integrates environmental stewardship, resource conservation, pollution control, and responsible material usage to minimize our ecological footprint. We strive for continuous improvement in environmental performance through innovation, responsible sourcing, and engagement with stakeholders to promote sustainable interiors.
declaration.declaration: Cherry Hill Interiors Pvt. Ltd. integrates environmental responsibility into its operations by reducing its carbon footprint, optimizing resource use, and ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations. With 2022 as the baseline year, sustainability improvements are driven through innovation, responsible design, and collaboration with industry leaders to achieve our long-term environmental targets.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all business operations, including office spaces, project sites, supply chains, and interactions with stakeholders. It extends to employees, contractors, suppliers, and partners engaged in our business activities.

focusAreas: Achieving Energy Efficiency and Lowering GHG Emissions
Reducing Air Pollution and Enhancing Air Quality
Advancing Responsible Material Use and Waste Management

Achieving Energy Efficiency and Lowering: To achieve greater energy efficiency and reduce greenhouse gas emissions, by integration of sustainable practices across operations such as expanded use of renewable energy sources, automation, and implementation of energy-efficient technologies.
Advancing Water Conservation and Reuse: To achieve efficient water management, by focusing on optimizing usage and increasing recycling efforts.
To integrate water-efficient technologies across operations, and promote responsible water use throughout our supply chain.
Reducing Air Pollution and Enhancing Air: To achieve a cleaner environment, by adoption of low-emission materials, improved ventilation systems, and implementation of advanced dust control mechanisms.
Advancing Responsible Material Use and W: To achieve responsible material use and minimize waste by prioritizing sustainable sourcing, improved waste segregation procedures, and enhanced circularity through collaborations with recycling firms.
Strengthening of waste management protocols to ensure responsible disposal and landfill diversion.
Protecting Biodiversity and Green Spaces: To achieve biodiversity conservation by increasing native tree plantations and incorporating eco-friendly landscaping.
To focus on collaboration with environmental organizations that support habitat preservation and ecological restoration.
Ensuring Customer Health and Safety: To maintain the highest standards of customer health and safety through responsible design practices, safe materials, and effective project management.
To create interior spaces that support occupant wellbeing through responsible material selection, ergonomic design, and adherence to health and safety best practices.
Driving Environmental Advocacy and Aware: To achieve greater sustainability awareness by engaging in industry collaborations, conducting employee training sessions, and participating in public advocacy initiatives.
Embedding environmental responsibility into corporate culture and stakeholder communications.

quantitative.area: Achieving Energy Efficiency and Lowering GHG Emissions

targets.target: To decrease the total energy consumption intensity by 10%
To lower the GHG emissions intensity by 5%
To reduce Scope 3 emissions intensity by 5%
To reduce water consumption intensity by 20% per square foot constructed
To increase water recycling and reuse intensity by 20% per project site where applicable

quantitative.area: Reducing Air Pollution and Enhancing Air Quality

targets.target: To maintain 100% compliance with national air quality standards
Adopt the utilization of 50% materials in interiors with low-VOC
To reduce airborne pollutant emissions intensity by 10% per construction project

quantitative.area: Advancing Responsible Material Use and Waste Management

targets.target: To ensure implementation of structured waste segregation across 100% of project sites
To utilize 10% of materials from recycled or sustainable sources
To reduce hazardous waste generation intensity by 15% through recycling and recovery
To achieve the target of planting 100 trees annually in project-associated areas
To dedicate 5% of our outdoor office spaces to green landscaping
Maintain zero customer-related health and safety incidents across all project sites and completed projects
To ensure 80% of furnishings are free from harmful chemicals
Conduct Sustainability training sessions twice in one year for employees and stakeholders
Develop one industry-wide initiative by promoting sustainable design and responsible resource use

policy.monitoring:
Cherry Hill Interiors is committed to monitoring its environmental performance across key focus areas, including energy efficiency, GHG emissions, water conservation, air quality, responsible material use, waste management, biodiversity, customer health and safety, and environmental awareness. Relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are established and tracked to assess progress against the company's sustainability objectives and targets.

Performance is reviewed periodically by management to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement. Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate achievements, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions where necessary. Progress and key outcomes are communicated to relevant stakeholders, as appropriate, to promote transparency and accountability. All monitoring and reporting activities are conducted in alignment with applicable legal requirements, industry best practices, and recognized sustainability standards.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Environmental Management policy is reviewed once after every two years or as required by the Environmental Manager to ensure alignment with regulatory changes, technological advancements, and industry best practices.

Regular audits and assessments are conducted to measure performance against targets.

Feedback from stakeholders are incorporated to enhance environmental initiatives.
